newsitem.title: SWEDEN: AssiDoman says to invest 725 mln Skr.
newsitem.headline: AssiDoman says to invest 725 mln Skr.

text.p: Swedish forestry group AssiDoman said on Tuesday it would invest 725 million crowns in two domestic plants.
The group said it would invest 485 million crowns in Skarblacka, Sweden, and 240 million crowns at its Kraftliner plant in Pitea in northern Sweden, the company said in a statement.
"The new investments will not mean any capacity increases," company spokesman Hans Palm told Reuters. "They are pure reinvestments."
In Skarblacka the largest investment is a new debarking and chipping unit for 365 million crowns, AssiDoman said.

The group has previously announced that it will rebuild parts of the Skarblacka plant and along with the new investments, Skarblacka investments will total more than 1.1 billion crowns, the company said.
At Kraftliner in Pitea, AssiDoman will rebuild a machine for 130 million crowns and build a new pulp washing unit for 110 million crowns.
